description: Gather the harness context a Muggle bug report carries: Muggle CLI and Studio versions, operating system, the last Muggle Test project selected for this directory, and the newest local run with its status. Values that look like secrets are dropped and named in strippedFieldNames. Read-only. Show the result to the user before filing, then pass the clientContext JSON block unchanged as clientContext to muggle-remote-bug-report-create.

cwd.description: Project root directory whose last-used Muggle Test project the context names.

name: muggle-local-bug-report-context-get
